summary: ParaZero Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing its first order for DefendAir counter-UAS systems from a U.S. federal agency. The order includes net launchers, Net Pods, and on-site operator training. No financial terms, prices, or closing conditions were disclosed. This is a routine business development announcement, not a special situation. It does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. The filing is an ordinary current report on Form 6-K, and the registrant is the filer.
